root_cause: Claimant cannot determine whether the object that caused damage was part of the claimant's own property (own tree) or originated from neighbor (neighbor's tree blown over or neighbor's shed debris). This distinction affects coverage routing: damage from policyholder's own tree = property_damage; damage from neighbor's property = potential liability claim against neighbor's insurer.

case_facts.description: tree or neighbor's shed material struck property; damage to parked car, garage roof, and fence; emergency services on scene
case_facts.property_affected: parked car, garage roof, section of fence
case_facts.source_uncertain: possibly tree or possibly neighbor's shed debris

recommended_action: Adjuster must conduct on-site inspection and determine the source of the damaging object. If investigation confirms it originated from policyholder's property, route claim to property_damage adjuster. If it originated from neighbor's property/negligence, coordinate with neighbor's insurance or treat as third-party claim. High-severity status warrants urgent deployment regardless.
